an9.67:1.1: LXVII. Pañc' imāni bhikkhave orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni. Katamāni pañca? Sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo. Imāni kho bhikkhave pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
an9.67:2.1: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya . . . ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā ti.
